title: Hester's Ledger page text, version 1
description: One Ledger Page text per file under content/ledger/ (work order 024, section 4: the Hester's Ledger screen reads one file per page). 'id' is ledger.<zone>.<name>, zone one of rustmoor, cinderworks, thunderhead, global (the same list as item ids); the file is content/ledger/<zone>.<name>.json, the id without its 'ledger.' prefix (the schema check's file-name rule). 'item' is the Ledger Page item the text belongs to, an item id; that it exists under content/items/ and that no other page names it are the references check's. 'reveal_layer' is 0 (no reveal) to 3, as for storylets; the reveal check reads the page as belonging to its layer's act, so its prose may hold no reveal word from a later act. 'title' is one non-blank line. 'text' is the page's prose, non-blank, and may run to several lines. Banned words in both are the style check's; no word limit is set for either yet (check_style.LEDGER_TITLE_MAX_WORDS and LEDGER_TEXT_MAX_WORDS). The shape is fixed by the engine's loader, so the file takes no other field, 'revision' included: its register row's revision is null.
